bio.text: Mark DeCaprio was elected to his second term in the Connecticut House in November 2024, representing the 48th District, which includes Bozrah, Colchester, Franklin and parts of Lebanon.
He enlisted in the U.S. Navy Submarine Service and served four years of active duty, including on a nuclear submarine in New London.
He earned a B.S. in biology from Eastern Connecticut State University and a master's in public health from the University of Connecticut.

He worked for the state Department of Public Health and retired from the Department of Energy & Environmental Protection, where he spent his last 20 years as a division director for emergency oil and chemical spill response.
